name: Ginan (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ginan town emblem in orange: a broken ring above two leaf-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ginan, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 July 1986.

features.role: Ginan town emblem — a broken ring above two leaf-like strokes
